text: oh, i guess this is relevant also, but if you look at the water painting tool. im pretty sure if i remember correctly, it requres that you have to have a negative heightfield to then be able to paint in water. but as it stands, the heightfield tool is only allowed to do positive. now, i kinda also think this is kinda a bad hack if you ask me, and that the water tool should do its own negative depth on any terrain, that way you know for example you could put a river flowing down a hill.
